reasons.create-bucket: localstack ENTRYPOINT + in-memory bucket state not captured by docker commit
reasons.mteb-eval: image broken by dependency drift (transformers 5.x), oracle cannot run
reasons.parallelize-graph: oracle rebuilds Berkeley UPC (~10 min) per snapshot; cost prohibitive
reasons.word2vec-from-scratch: Dockerfile downloads HF dataset at build time; build fails on both hosts
reasons.build-linux-kernel-qemu: kernel build per snapshot is hours; oracle produces no bzImage under emulation
reasons.mcmc-sampling-stan: oracle cannot install rstan (cmake missing in image); 4x100k MCMC exceeds test timeout
reasons.vul-flink: oracle is a ~45 min networked maven build; per-snapshot cost prohibitive
reasons.mteb-retrieve: image broken by dependency drift (transformers 5.x); oracle exits 1 on pristine image
reasons.acl-permissions-inheritance: POSIX ACL xattrs do not survive docker commit snapshots (verified: 13 ACL entries -> 6 after commit); state cannot be snapshotted faithfully
reasons.query-optimize: official test executes a ~190 s query twice per snapshot; 4 trajectories x ~17 snapshots x 3 reps is >20 h; cost prohibitive
